newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds buoyed, focus on Jan inflation.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds buoyed, focus on Jan inflation.

text.p: 1740 GMT - Portuguese bonds closed buoyed as investors turned their attention to January prices data due on Friday.
*Feb 06 cash 119.44 (119.20), yld 6.57 pct vs 6.61 pct cls
*Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash -1 bps vs 0 bps cls
Portuguese bonds closed buoyed in line with peripheral markets with some selling at the shorter end of the yield curve as investors turned their attention to January inflation data due on Friday.
"Futures and 10-year bonds closed well-supported in sympathy with the peripherals," said a fixed rate director.
Another said: "The possibility that our year-on-year inflation could rise in January sparked selling by foreign investors of bonds with maturities of up to three years."
The escudo closed at the day's lows against the mark after a dull session and stood at 100.45/48 per mark at 1808 GMT.
